threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check your phone for the bus schedule instead of looking up at the timetable on the stop. Local buses are like secret pop-up gigs here.
Last week on the 35, a guy was arguing with a statue outside the Ritzy for ten minutes. The bus just stared, waiting for him to leave.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Finally saw the sausage stand open at 3 AM, while the scent of fresh currywurst lingered in the air. It hit me—this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves cocktails infused with trashy '90s nostalgia—think neon drinks inspired by old TV shows. So odd, yet so perfect.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by the way they know to keep an eye out for the dog that blocks the Muni tracks every other week—classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in a full tuxedo hop on the 47, juggling a bouquet of flowers. Only in SF do you go from black tie to bus ride in a heartbeat.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all tapas are for sharing; locals often order their own favorites and rarely share a plate.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their reluctance to sit on the plaça benches—still thinking they’re for decoration, not lounging.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think double-decker buses are cool and not just overcrowded mobile waiting rooms for late arrivals.
Last night on the 196, a guy in a full tuxedo hopped on, looking like he just left a wedding. He ordered a chicken burger from his bag mid-ride. Hilarious!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a toddler confidently riding a bike, dodging potholes like a local. It's the little victories that say I've arrived.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how in Kreuzberg, it's not uncommon to see a spontaneous street performance outside a kebab shop? Feels like art and late-night snacks go hand in hand.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they’ve got that secret spot for tacos off the alley, not just the trendy places everyone raves about.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy giving a full concert on the bus today, complete with mic and backup dancers. Just another day in the Tenderloin!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Gràcia's all about Gaudí. But it's the quirky backstreets and local bars that tell the real story—those hidden gems are golden.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they still look at the metro map like it's a treasure map, searching for the fastest route instead of just hopping on.
